name: ghl-visual-newsletter-by-scale
origin: New reusable workflow authored at owner request from completed private GHL newsletter tasks; not copied from a vendor skill.
source_boundary: Private task exports and approvals remain in the authorized source workspace. This public package contains only generalized procedures and writing-method page locators.
basis: Owner preference: existing GHL first, preserve approved design, duplicate before rewriting, useful relaxed note and gentle reply invitation.
Observed native Design Editor import, editing, save/reload and preview behavior; historical observations require live rediscovery.
Nicolas Cole writing-method references paraphrased with page locators; canonical PDF and client copy are not bundled.
transformations: Removed all client names, account/template IDs, customer contact details, private URLs, image exports and subscriber-specific tracking.
Generalized case-specific image restrictions and copy direction without implying universal campaign authorization.
dependencies: Authenticated access to the intended GHL account and supported host browser or suitable connected tools.
Authorized client source material and assets.
Writer book-only mode additionally needs its locally authorized canonical PDF; not required to operate GHL elsewhere.

validation.live_run: Not run by packaging; underlying procedure comes from completed tasks. No customer action performed during packaging.

exclusions: No client exports, screenshots, logos, contact data, account mappings, browser state, credentials or canonical book material.
No new license; existing repository licensing and attribution preserved.
unresolved: No new unresolved VPS source variant. Broader historical provenance/access limitations remain in the existing inventories.
